1: // Simple asteroid‑shower game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return; // safety
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   const { width, height } = canvas;
9: 
10:   // ----- game objects -----
11:   const ship = { x: width / 2, y: height - 30, w: 40, h: 20, speed: 5 };
12:   const lasers = [];
13:   const asteroids = [];
14:   let left = false, right = false, fire = false;
15:   let gameOver = false;
16: 
17:   // ----- input handling -----
18:   document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
19:     if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') left = true;
20:     if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') right = true;
21:     if (e.code === 'Space') fire = true;
22:   });
23:   document.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
24:     if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') left = false;
25:     if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') right = false;
26:     if (e.code === 'Space') fire = false;
27:   });
28: 
29:   // ----- helpers -----
30:   const rectCollide = (a, b) =>
31:     a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
32: 
33:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
34:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
35:     const x = Math.random() * (width - size);
36:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
37:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -size, w: size, h: size, speed });
38:   };
39: 
40:   // ----- main loop -----
41:   let lastSpawn = 0;
42:   function update(dt) {
43:     if (gameOver) return;
44: 
45:     // ship movement
46:     if (left) ship.x -= ship.speed;
47:     if (right) ship.x += ship.speed;
48:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width - ship.w, ship.x));
49: 
50:     // fire lasers
51:     if (fire) {
52:       // limit fire rate
53:       if (!ship.lastShot || Date.now() - ship.lastShot > 200) {
54:         lasers.push({ x: ship.x + ship.w / 2 - 2, y: ship.y, w: 4, h: 10, speed: 7 });
55:         ship.lastShot = Date.now();
56:       }
57:     }
58: 
59:     // update lasers
60:     lasers.forEach(l => l.y -= l.speed);
61:     // remove off‑screen lasers
62:     for (let i = lasers.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
63:       if (lasers[i].y + lasers[i].h < 0) lasers.splice(i, 1);
64:     }
65: 
66:     // spawn asteroids every 1‑1.5 s
67:     if (Date.now() - lastSpawn > 1000 + Math.random() * 500) {
68:       spawnAsteroid();
69:       lastSpawn = Date.now();
70:     }
71: 
72:     // update asteroids
73:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.y += a.speed);
74: 
75:     // collisions: laser‑asteroid
76:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
77:       const a = asteroids[i];
78:       // asteroid hits ship?
79:       if (rectCollide(a, ship)) { gameOver = true; break; }
80:       // asteroid reaches bottom?
81:       if (a.y > height) { gameOver = true; break; }
82:       for (let j = lasers.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
83:         if (rectCollide(a, lasers[j])) {
84:           asteroids.splice(i, 1);
85:           lasers.splice(j, 1);
86:           break;
87:         }
88:       }
89:     }
90:   }
91: 
92:   function draw() {
93:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
94:     // ship
95:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0af';
96:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
97:     // lasers
98:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
99:     lasers.forEach(l => ctx.fillRect(l.x, l.y, l.w, l.h));
100:     // asteroids
101:     ctx.fillStyle = '#777';
102:     asteroids.forEach(a => ctx.beginPath(), ctx.arc(a.x + a.w/2, a.y + a.h/2, a.w/2, 0, Math.PI*2), ctx.fill());
103:     if (gameOver) {
104:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
105:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
106:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
107:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
108:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
109:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width/2, height/2);
110:     }
111:   }
112: 
113:   let last = 0;
114:   function loop(timestamp) {
115:     const dt = timestamp - last;
116:     last = timestamp;
117:     update(dt);
118:     draw();
119:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
120:   }
121:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
122: })();
